==Description==
'''No Target''' is a status effect that makes towers unable to target enemies with it.

==Mechanics==
When an enemy has '''No Target''', it cannot be targeted by towers. This, however, does not mean they cannot be damaged by towers. They may receive indirect damage, such as indirect [[Splash Damage]], though towers will not target it directly. A player-operated [[Gatling Gun]] and [[consumables]] can target enemies with '''No Target'''. There are however some enemies which will, alongside '''No Target''', either become invulnerable or redirect the damage elsewhere.

==Enemy List==
*[[Siege Engine]]
*[[Frost Ravager]] (Temporaily after it loses its shield)
*[[Frost Spirit]] (after the ''Ice Beacon'' ability until all [[Ice Beacon]]s are killed)
*[[Void Keeper]] (during its ''Summon'' ability)
*[[Void Caster]] (while the [[Void Reaver]] is alive)
